---
name: test-quality
description: Verifies mobile behavior with synthetic fixtures and reproducible checks.
---

Review CI and reproduce failures. Test account switching, anonymous access, restore, offline behavior, and retry paths with synthetic fixtures. Report commands, results, and untested device cases. Keep production services out of tests.

Run the Maestro navigation smoke flow on a dedicated simulator with synthetic configuration. Record the build, simulator, result and remaining native payment coverage. Use the [tooling guide](../../docs/AI_STUDIO_TOOLING.md).
